image_prompt.text: Collapsed wall sections and heaps of rubble standing across the arena floor, tall enough to break line of sight and duck behind mid-fight
Already-cracked masonry and stacked debris that fractures further under fire, so the ruined cover degrades as the fight goes on
Post-apocalyptic ruin dressing throughout an abandoned, enclosed arena — shattered concrete, twisted rebar, scorch marks and scattered debris across the floor

layout_placement.text: Points around the ruined perimeter — wall breaches and collapsed doorways — where zombies enter the arena mid-fight
Expose tunable attributes on the generated arena for wall height, rubble density, and floor colour

notes: Preset caveat: took Boss Raid on its own arena-flat shape but dropped hazard-kill — the prompt says small and enclosed, and ring-out edges or bottomless pits are the opposite of an enclosed arena.

Classification was close on the zombie theme: the skill treats a bare zombie game as Survival, but this prompt's form is an arena and nothing survival-specific (shelter, resources, escape, chase) is described, so Action leads alone and survival.md was not loaded.

arena-flat is specified as free of minor tripping geometry, which sits in mild tension with the requested floor debris — built the debris as visual dressing on a clean flat floor rather than as collidable clutter.
The attribute-exposure request is a parameterisation ask rather than geometry; filed under layout_placement because attributes are properties of geometry, not geometry itself.

would have asked: Sounds like a wave-fight arena — one flat, walled floor of a ruined city block, rubble and broken walls standing as cover you can shoot apart, and breaches around the edge where the zombies come in. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?
would have asked: whether the rubble and broken walls should be breakable cover that degrades during a fight or fixed scenery — kept them breakable, which is the preset default.
would have asked: whether spawns should be screened or set back at the arena edge (anti-camp placement) — not taken, since the prompt says nothing about where players enter.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
